title: Parkin Cake
hookLine: British-inspired parkin cake with 9 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Parkin Cake
steps.instructionTemplate: Heat oven to 160C/140C fan/gas 3. Grease a deep 22cm/9in square cake tin and line with baking parchment. Beat the egg and milk together with a fork. Incorporate {m52902_1}, {m52902_2}, {m52902_3}, and {m52902_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure butter first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Build Flavor: Parkin Cake
steps.instructionTemplate: Gently melt the syrup, treacle, sugar and butter together in a large pan until the sugar has dissolved. Remove from the heat. Mix together the oatmeal, flour and ginger and stir into the syrup mixture, followed by the egg and milk. Incorporate {m52902_5}, {m52902_6}, {m52902_7}, {m52902_8}, and {m52902_9} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Shape & Layer: Parkin Cake
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour the mixture into the tin and bake for 50 mins - 1 hr until the cake feels firm and a little crusty on top. Cool in the tin then wrap in more parchment and foil and keep for 3-5 days before eating if you can – it’ll become softer and stickier the longer you leave it, up to 2 weeks.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Wait until the sponge feels cool to the touch before frosting so your glaze or cream stays thick and glossy.

steps.title: Cool Completely, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Transfer Parkin Cake to a wire cooling rack and let it cool for 15–20 minutes so the interior sets cleanly without crumbling. Lift out using the parchment overhang, garnish as desired, and slice into 6 portions.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 45 mins!
